text: Qutaibah said in his narration:"For that is the Ribat, that is the Ribat, that is the Ribat" three times

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 56
text: Safinah narrated:"The Prophet would perform Wudu with a Mudd, and he would perform Ghusl with a Sa

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 68
text: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Let none of you urinate [in still water, then perform Wudu with it]

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 74
text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah and Ibn 'Abbas said:"Faith increases and decreases

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 75
text: It was narrated that Abu Darda' said:"Faith increases and decreases

author: Muwatta Malik 40
text: Yahya related to me from Malik from Nafithat Ibn Umar used to sleep sitting and then would pray without doing wudu

author: Muwatta Malik 67
text: Yahya related to me from Malik from Nafi that Abdullah ibn Umar used two fingers to take water to his ears

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 14
text: Narrated Abu Huraira: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, none of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father and his children

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 15
text: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said "None of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father, his children and all mankind

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 75
text: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me and said, "O Allah! Bestow on him the knowledge of the Book (Qur'an)

author: Sahih Muslim 131
text: Abu Malik narrated on the authority of his father that he heard the Apostle (ﷺ) say:He who held belief in the unity of Allah, and then narrated what has been stated above

author: Sahih Muslim 136
text: It is narrated on the authority of 'Uthman that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. He who died knowing (fully well) that there is no god but Allah entered Paradise

author: Sahih Muslim 137
text: It is narrated on the authority of Humran that he heard Uthman saying this:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttering these words (as stated above)

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 5
text: Another tradition on the authority of Anas has:" O Allaah, I seek refuge in Thee." Shu'bah said: Anas sometimes reported the words: "I take refuge in Allah

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 10
text: Narrated Ma'qil ibn AbuMa'qil al-Asadi: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has forbidden us to face the two qiblahs at the time of urination or excretion

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 51
text: Shuraih asked 'Aishah:"What would the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) do as soon as he entered the house?" She replied: "(He would use) the siwak

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 59
text: Narrated AbulMalih: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Allah does not accept charity from goods acquired by embezzlement as He does not accept prayer without purification

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 4
text: Jabir bin 'Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The key to Paradise is Salat, and the key to Salat is Wudu

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 6
text: Anas bin Malik said:"When the Prophet would enter the toilet 'He said: "O Allah! Indeed I seek refuge in You from Al-Khubith and Al- Khaba'ith

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 14
text: Anas, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, said:"When the Prophet wanted to relieve himself, he would not raise his garment until he was close to the ground

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 19
text: Aishah said:"Encourage your Husbands to clean themselves with water, for I am too shy of them, and Allah's Messenger would do that

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 39
text: Ibn Abbas narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When performing Wudu go between the fingers of your hands and (toes of) your feet

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 76
text: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed Allah does not accept the prayer of one of you when he commits Hadath, until he performs Wudu

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 4
text: Abu Ja'far said:"Whenever Ibn 'Umar heard a Hadith from the Messanger of Allah (ﷺ), he would not do more than it said, and he would not do less

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 8
text: Abu 'Inabah Al-Khawlani said that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Allah will continue to plant new people in this religion and use them in His obedience

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 14
text: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever innovates something in this matter of ours (i.e. Islam) that is not part of it, will have it rejected

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 24
text: Muhammad bin Sirin said :"Whenever Anas bin Malik finished narrating a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), he would say, 'Or as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 31
text: It was narrated from that 'Ali said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Do not tell lies about me, for telling lies about me leads to Hell (Fire)

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 33
text: It was narrated from that Jabir said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever tells lies about me deliberately, let him take his place in Hell

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 34
text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever attributes to me something that I have not said, let him take his place in Hell

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 37
text: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever tells lies about me deliberately, let him take his place in Hell

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 69
text: It was narrated that 'Abdullah said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Verbally abusing a Muslim is immorality and fighting him is Kufr (disbelief)

author: Muwatta Malik 44
text: Yahya related to me from Malik from Nafi that Abdullah ibn Umar used to say that men and their wives used to do wudu together in the time of the Messenger of Allah

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 11
text: Narrated Abu Musa: Some people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Whose Islam is the best? i.e. (Who is a very good Muslim)?" He replied, "One who avoids harming the Muslims with his tongue and hands

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 56
text: Narrated Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You will be rewarded for whatever you spend for Allah's sake even if it were a morsel which you put in your wife's mouth

author: Sahih Muslim 133
text: The same hadith is mentioned through a different chain except it ends where it mentions that Allah revealed the verses and it does not mention the verses. There is also a slight variation in words

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 13
text: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us to face the qiblah at the time of making water. Then I saw him facing it (qiblah) urinating or easing himself one year before his death

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 40
text: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any of you goes to relieve himself, he should take with him three stones to cleans himself, for they will be enough for him

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 52
text: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) would clean his teeth with the Siwak, then he would give me the Siwak in order to wash it. So I would first use it myself, then wash it and return it

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 60
text: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Apostle of Allaah ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) said : Allaah, the Exalted, does not accept the prayer of any of you when you are defiled until you performed ablution

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 18
text: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Do not perform Istinja, with dung, nor with bones. For indeed it is provisions for your brothers among the Jinn

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 22
text: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "If it were not that it would be difficult on my nation, then I would have ordered them to use the Siwak for each prayer

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 27
text: Salamah bin Qais narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When you perform Wudu then sniff water in the nose and blow it out, and when you use small stones (to remove filth) then make it odd (numbered)

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 59
text: It has been related in a narration from Ibn Umar that :the Prophet said: "Whoever performs Wudu while in a state of purity, Allah writes for him on account of it ten good merits

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 75
text: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you is in the Masjid, and he senses wind between his buttocks then he should not exit until he hears a sound or smells an odor

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 7
text: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A group of my Ummah will continue to adhere steadfastly to the command of Allah and those who oppose them will not be able to harm them

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 22
text: It was narrated from Abu Salamah that :Abu Hurairah said to a man "O son of my brother, when I narrate a Hadith of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), to you, then do not try to make any examples for it

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 26
text: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Abu Safar said:"I heard Ash-Sha'bi saying: 'I sat with Ibn 'Umar for a year and I did not hear him narrate anything from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 30
text: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud that his father said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever tells lies about me deliberately, let him take his place in Hell

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 32
text: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever tells lies about me', I (the narrator) think that he also said 'deliberately', let him take his place in Hell

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 41
text: It was narrated that Mughirah bin Shu'bah said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: '"Whoever narrates a Hadith from me thinking it to be false, then he is one of the two liars

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 50
text: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Allah refuses to accept the good deeds of one who follows innovation until he gives up that innovation

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 53
text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever is given a Fatwa (verdict) that has no basis, then his sin will be upon the one who issued that Fatwa

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 58
text: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said heard a man urging his brother to be modest. He said: 'Indeed modesty is a branch of faith

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 62
text: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'There are two types of people among this Ummah who have no share of Islam: The Murji'ah and the Qadariyyah

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 66
text: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother" or he said "for his neighbor, what he loves for himself

author: Sunan Ibn Majah 67
text: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his child, his father and all the people

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 13
text: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself

author: Sahih al-Bukhari 17
text: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Love for the Ansar is a sign of faith and hatred for the Ansar is a sign of hypocrisy

author: Sahih Muslim 122
text: The above hadith has been mentioned with a different chain with a slightly different wording at the beginning, then follows the same

author: Sahih Muslim 152
text: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Iman has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of Iman

author: Sahih Muslim 155
text: Zuhri has narrated this hadith with the addition of these words:He (the Holy Prophet) happened to pass by a mass of Ansar who was instructing his brother (about modesty)

author: Sahih Muslim 157
text: Ishaq b. Ibrahim narrates this hadith of the Prophet on the authority of Imran b. Husain, like the one narrated by Hammad b. Zaid

author: Sahih Muslim 162
text: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that he heard the (Holy Prophet) say:A Muslim is he from whose hand and tongue the Muslims are safe

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 2
text: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: When the Prophet (ﷺ) felt the need of relieving himself, he went far off where no one could see him

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 18
text: Narrated A'ishah:The Apostle of Allaah ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) used to remember Allaah, the Great and Majestic, at all moments

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 24
text: Narrated Umaymah daughter of Ruqayqah: The Prophet (ﷺ) had a wooden vessel under his bed in which he would urinate at night

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 32
text: Narrated Hafsah, Ummul Mu'minin: The Prophet (ﷺ) used his right hand for taking his food and drink and used his left hand for other purposes

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 38
text: Narrated Jabir b. 'Abd Allaah:The Apostle of Allaah ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) forbade us to use a bone or dung for wiping

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 55
text: Narrated Hudhaifah:When the Apostle of Allaah (sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam) got up during the night (to pray), he cleansed his mouth with the tooth-stick

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 57
text: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The Prophet (ﷺ) did not get up after sleeping by night or by day without using the tooth-stick before performing ablution

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 69
text: Narrated Abu Hurairah :The Prophet ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) said : None amongst you should urinate in stagnant water , and then wash in it

author: Sunan Abu Dawud 70
text: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should urinate in standing water, then wash in it after sexual defilement

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3
text: Ali narrated that :the Prophet, said: "The key to Salat is the purification, its Tahrlm is the Takblr, and its Tahlil is the Taslim

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 9
text: Jabir bin Abdullah said:"The Prophet prohibited us from facing the Qiblah while urinating. Then i saw him facing it a year before he died

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 11
text: Ibn 'Umar said:"One day I climbed on Hafsah's house, and I saw the Prophet relieving himself while facing Ash-Sham, with his back toward the Ka'bah

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 15
text: Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah narrated from his father:"The Prophet prohibited that a man should touch his penis with his right hand

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 20
text: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah said:I was with the Prophet on a journey. The Prophet had to relieve himself, so he went far away

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 26
text: Rabah Bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sufyan bin Huwaitib narrated :the same from his grandmother the daughter of Sa'eed bin Zaid, from her father, from the Prophet

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 35
text: Abdullah bin Zaid narrated that :he saw the Prophet performing Wudu, and that he wiped his head with water that was not left over from his hands

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 38
text: Asim bin Laqit bin Sabirah narrated from his father that :the Prophet Muhammad said: "When performing Wudu go between the fingers

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 40
text: Al-Mustawrid bin Shaddad Al-Fihri said :"I saw the Prophet when he was performing Wudu doing that to the toes on his feet with his pinky

author: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 46
text: Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah said, :"1 asked Abu Ja'far: 'Did Jabir narrate to you that: "The Prophet performed Wudu one time each?" He said: "Yes
